name: SBOL Visual
by: the SBOL developers (the Synthetic Biology Open Language community, SynBioDex), whose SBOL Visual standard defines these glyphs for genetic designs, molecular species and their interactions
credit: SBOL Visual glyphs, the SBOL developers (github.com/SynBioDex/SBOL-visual), CC0 1.0
plain: Creative Commons Zero 1.0 (CC0): the SBOL developers waived all copyright in the SBOL Visual glyphs, so you may use, change and share them for any purpose, also commercially, without asking and without giving credit. The waiver is the exception in the repository's LICENSE.html, which puts the rest of the repository (the specification text, its examples and documents) under CC BY 4.0; this pack holds the glyphs only, taken from the GitHub repository (the sbolstandard.org website is under another license and was not used). This pack is not endorsed by the SBOL developers.
ask: Exception: to the extent possible under law, the SBOL developers have waived all copyright and related or neighboring rights to SBOL Visual glyphs.
how: No credit is required (the SBOL developers ask for none), and SiliCoDraw adds no credit line for these glyphs. If you want to name the standard (useful when a figure follows it), Page → Copy full icon credits gives a line for it.
changes: Converted from SVG to SiliCoDraw's icon format: each glyph fitted into a 100 × 100 box by what it draws (so the glyphs no longer share one scale or sit on their backbone line), style sheets written out as attributes, an arrowhead drawn as a marker written out as a shape, metadata removed, coordinates rounded, and the color made recolorable; the white fill of the single-stranded nucleic acid's open wave line, which showed as a white patch on a dark page, was taken off (the white interiors of Dissociation and of the Process node, which cover lines behind them, are kept). The characters some glyphs are made of (the ? of the replacement glyph, the brackets of No glyph assigned, the ellipsis of Omitted detail, the AAA of the polyA site, the asterisks of the stop sites) are set as outlines in another sans-serif face (MathJax's), since an icon holds no text; SBOL Visual leaves the face open. Each glyph was drawn and compared with the original on a white and on a dark page. Names follow the glyph sets of the repository. Left out: the specification and example drawings, the Deprecated glyphs, and the glyphs that are copies of another one (the replacement glyph, the No glyph assigned brackets and the SBGN nucleic-acid shape appear in several glyph sets: each is in the pack once).
